name: Cerise
source:
Cerise is a bubbly and hot tempered girl who is constantly hungry. She enjoys teasing Ailis and at times Einar. She's a troublemaker, but a good friend at heart. 

[From [url=https://cosmic-latte.itch.io/starlit-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
